name: HollowTreeFactory
caption: A hollow dead tree rendered as a textured 3D model. The object shows a bare deciduous tree standing upright with a thick, slightly irregular trunk that widens at the base. A prominent dark hollow cavity is visible on the front of the trunk, representing a natural rot hole or woodpecker cavity. The bark surface is smooth but lumpy with a warm sandy beige-tan coloring. Multiple bare branches extend outward from the upper trunk, bare and leafless, ranging from thick primary branches to slender secondary ones with knobby swollen joints and short twig stubs.
